firstEmail.subject: A practical enquiry idea for Harbour Heating
firstEmail.html:
Hello Morgan,

I was reviewing Harbour Heating's website and noticed that emergency call-outs, boiler servicing, and quote requests all lead visitors toward the same general contact route. That keeps the site simple, but it may leave your team asking the same questions by phone before a job can be prioritised.

FSS could shape a focused enquiry journey that asks for service type, postcode, urgency, and preferred contact time before the request reaches your team. The aim would be a clearer hand-off, not a larger system: a fast mobile form, useful confirmation for the customer, and an organised summary for whoever responds.

I have included a conceptual workflow image to make the idea concrete. This is a proposed design concept, not an existing Harbour Heating system or a claim about current results.

Would a short conversation next week be useful to test whether this fits how you handle enquiries?

If this is not relevant, reply opt out and I will send no further emails.

Regards,
Jean-Fidele
Faithful Software Solutions
